requests.description: I've been dreaming of a perfume that smells like a summer garden — flowers everywhere, nothing too complicated. Just something simple and beautiful.
requests.failure_feedback: Charlotte holds the bottle to her nose and sighs. "It's lovely, but... it doesn't feel like a garden to me. I was dreaming of real flowers — more than one kind, woven together. Could you try again?"

requests.description: I need something that wakes me up in the morning, you know? Like stepping outside and breathing in the cool air. Something green and alive.
requests.failure_feedback: Rémy takes a deep breath and frowns. "This isn't quite what I smell on the trail, you know? I need that green freshness — something that hits you right away, like a cool morning breeze."

requests.description: Can you make me something that reminds me of my grandfather's study? Old bookshelves, polished wood... something warm and steady.
requests.failure_feedback: Geneviève closes her eyes and shakes her head gently. "It's pleasant, but it doesn't remind me of what I'm looking for. I need that woody warmth — different woods layered together, the way grandfather's study smelled."

requests.description: I have the biggest sweet tooth — everyone knows it! I want a perfume that smells like a treat. Something cozy and indulgent, like dessert in a bottle.
requests.failure_feedback: Noëlle giggles and shakes her head. "Oh, it's interesting! But it's not quite sweet enough for me. I was dreaming of something more indulgent — cozy and rich, with enough depth to really feel like a treat."

requests.description: I'm going on a date and I want to smell unforgettable. Something with real depth — flowers, yes, but with layers underneath. A scent that lingers after I've left the room.
requests.failure_feedback: Charlotte presses the bottle to her heart and shakes her head. "It's pleasant, but it doesn't make my heart race. I need flowers with real depth — layers underneath, something that lingers. A blend with substance, not just pretty."

requests.description: I don't need anything fancy. I work long days and I want something bright that keeps me sharp. Citrus, probably — something clean and efficient. But make sure it's well-made, I don't like shoddy work.
requests.failure_feedback: Pierre examines the bottle matter-of-factly. "It's not bad, but let's be direct: I need something citrusy with a bright opening, and it has to be well-crafted. Something that actually does the job."

requests.description: Grand-mère always said the base of a perfume is its soul. I'd like something grounded — strong base notes with real presence. The kind of scent she would have approved of. Quality matters. She was very particular.
requests.failure_feedback: Geneviève's expression turns wistful. "It's lovely, but it doesn't have the depth I remember. Grand-mère's perfume had such weight to it — different base notes working together, with real quality. This isn't quite there yet."

requests.description: I go walking in the woods at dusk and it's my favorite time of day. The air smells like pine and earth and the last warmth of the sun. Can you capture that? I want all three layers — the top, the heart, the base. The whole evening in a bottle.
requests.failure_feedback: Rémy shakes his head like a trail guide turning you back. "You're close to that twilight feeling, but I need the whole evening — all three layers, plenty of different oils working together, and the quality to match. Nature doesn't cut corners."

requests.description: I'm hosting and everything must be perfect. I need a perfume that's complex — multiple floral notes woven together, supported by something complementary. Not just flowers thrown in a bottle. I'll know the difference. Don't disappoint me.
requests.failure_feedback: Margot wrinkles her nose ever so slightly. "This is close, but I need something more refined. Multiple floral notes, supported by other families — a complex blend with real craftsmanship. Do try again."

requests.description: My happiest memories are by the fire with my family — the smell of cedar logs, something sweet baking, warm spices in the air. I want all of that in one bottle. Something that makes you feel like you're home.
requests.failure_feedback: Bernard gives you a kind smile. "I can almost smell the cabin, but it's not quite there yet. I need woody warmth with sweet or spicy notes, all three layers represented, and real depth. Take your time — I know you'll get it."

requests.description: I want something really special — not just sweet, but a whole composition. Like an orchestra where every instrument has its part. Sweet at the heart, but with brightness on top and depth underneath. And please, use one of those special combinations you've discovered. I love what you've been creating lately.
requests.failure_feedback: Noëlle tastes the air and shakes her head with a warm smile. "It smells delicious, but my art demands perfection! I need sweetness, all three layers, one of your special combinations, and quality that sings. Like baking — no shortcuts!"

requests.description: Darling, I need a perfume for an event that people will talk about for WEEKS. It needs to be dramatic — rich, complex, unforgettable. Use every trick you've learned. I want layers, I want an accord, I want it aged to perfection. Spare no effort. This is my moment.
requests.failure_feedback: Simone gasps and clutches her pearls. "Darling, no! It's good, but it's not gala-worthy. I need something truly complex — aged, built on an accord, with every layer represented and quality that would make the judges weep. This is my moment!"

requests.description: This is a big ask, dear. My grandmother had a signature scent — I've spent years trying to describe it. Woody at its core, but there was something more... layers I could never quite name. I need your very best work. Take your time. Age it properly. Make something worthy of her memory.
requests.failure_feedback: Geneviève holds the bottle with trembling hands. "I can tell you put heart into this, and that means the world. But it's not quite the legacy piece I need. Woody at its core, with layers, aged properly, built on one of your special combinations... and the very highest quality. For her memory."
